strategy_family: AdaptiveTrend-Lite: completed 6-hour trend, slow asset selection, dynamic volatility sizing, one long/cash position

pre_registered_rules.universe: BTC, ETH, BNB, XRP, ADA, DOGE, SOL public spot/perpetual OHLCV only
pre_registered_rules.signal: At each completed 6h candle, select the single asset with best trailing 28-day return, require its 28-day return > 0, otherwise cash
pre_registered_rules.trend_confirmation: Selected asset must also have close above completed 6h EMA(20); no intrabar lookahead
pre_registered_rules.sizing: Target annualized volatility 35%, realized vol from trailing 20 completed 6h returns, cap notional at $5 normal and $10 absolute
pre_registered_rules.execution: next 6h open, one open position, DCA=0, pessimistic intrabar ordering, adverse gap handling
pre_registered_rules.costs: 7 bps/side base, 10 bps/side stress, plus 2 bps adverse slippage per fill; exact funding if perpetual
pre_registered_rules.account_constraints: $15 equity, daily profit lock +$0.50, daily loss gate -$0.30, current exchange min notional and quantity filters
pre_registered_rules.validation: development segment, chronological folds, one sealed final only after all gates pass; no parameter sweep

authoritative_prior_evidence: AdaptiveTrend paper (arXiv:2602.11708, Feb 2026) motivates 6-hour trend, volatility-calibrated stops and slow portfolio adaptation, but its 150+ pair, asymmetric long-short setup is not directly transferable to this $15 one-position long/cash constraint.

Recent crypto momentum evidence reports time-series momentum outperforming cross-sectional momentum on risk-adjusted basis, supporting a conservative long/cash test rather than a long-short replication.

data_status.required: Verified public 6h OHLCV across the full study window plus exchange minimum filters and funding when perpetual
data_status.result: No verified dataset/evidence artifact was available in the repository main branch for a reproducible execution-grade run in this iteration; no substitute coarse or synthetic data was used.

rejection_reason: No valid out-of-sample backtest could be completed without verified public data and current filter metadata. Candidate is not admitted, and no monthly profit estimate is inferred.
next_step: Keep current best frozen: 30-day long/cash TSMOM pending forward paper evidence. Next distinct queue item remains long/cash residual momentum after removing BTC or equal-weight market beta, but only after obtaining a reproducible public-data snapshot.
